Amazon Black Friday 2026 now live – Main Event

Amazon kicked off its Black Friday Week sale eight days ago, but the main event is now finally here. While some folks like to wait until actual Black Friday (November 27 this year) to see if prices are going to drop any lower, and understandably so, it has already been an incredibly eventful sale with some seriously big ticket items dropping so low they couldn’t possibly get slashed again. However, today is the day, so check your carts and get ready as the chances of anything dropping all that much lower (if at all) than we have right now is slim.

When is the official Amazon Black Friday sale?


Amazon’s Black Friday Week started on November 19, but the main event goes live on Black Friday, November 27, 2026. 

How long does the Amazon Black Friday sale last?


Technically speaking Amazon’s Black Friday sale runs through November 27 before it transitions into a Cyber Monday weekend sale, but the deals will run right through Monday, November 30. 

Will prices get even lower on actual Black Friday?


Sometimes yes, sometimes no. Retailers, Amazon included, have become incredibly aggressive with early discounts and often deliver the best deals of the season on select items well ahead of Black Friday. That’s, however, not always the case and some gear will drop lower as the sale progresses. 

What time does the Amazon Black Friday sale start?


The official Amazon Black Friday main event sale begins at 3:00 a.m. ET on November 27, 2026. 

What time does the Amazon Black Friday sale end?


The official Amazon Black Friday main event sale ends at 11:59 p.m. PT on November 27, 2026/2:59 a.m. ET on November 28.
